source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting excessive industrial emissions in an air-quality report

1. Start with the monitoring records.
2.
completion:
Record date, time, and duration of emissions.
3. Note down the substances emitted (such as SOx, NOx, VOCs, particulate matter, etc.)
4. Quantify the level of emission (use relevant measurement units, e.g., ppm, mg/m3, tons per year).
5. Note any deviation from permitted emissions, specifying the legal limits and observed excess.
6. Document the type of industry and the specific process involved.
7. Provide meteorological data (temperature, humidity, wind speed/direction).
8. Specify the method of measurement or collection (e.g., continuous emission monitoring systems, stack sampling).
9. Take photographs or videos to visually represent the emissions.
10. Include any Sensor data (if available, such as from air quality monitoring stations).
11. Note any malfunctions or operating conditions that might have led to the excessive emissions.
12. Cite any relevant regulations or standards that were violated.
13.
